What do I get with the Mailchimp AMS Connector?

Your AMS stays the system of record for full transaction detail, while Mailchimp gets clean fields and tags.

  • Campaigns on timeCampaigns go out the moment a member joins, registers or nears renewal.

Questions

What associations ask about the Mailchimp AMS Connector

What data does the connector sync?

Thirty standard member fields covering identity, contact, professional, membership and demographic data, plus member activity as tags in five categories.

How does it handle registrations, purchases and donations?

It turns that activity into clean tags you can segment on, rather than loading full transaction history into Mailchimp. Your AMS keeps the detail.

How often does data sync?

Once a day. If a sync fails, you get an automated alert and the connector retries at the next sync.

How tech-savvy does our team need to be?

Not at all. You tell us what data to move, and our specialists handle the rest.

What if our AMS has downtime?

The connector logs errors and sends an automated alert, then retries at the next scheduled sync.

How do we connect our AMS to Mailchimp?

Use a connector that syncs on a schedule instead of manual imports. The Ricochet Mailchimp AMS Connector moves thirty standard member fields and turns activity such as events, gifts and certifications into tags you can segment on. It works with nearly every AMS, matches records on your AMS Member ID and syncs once a day.

Why do AMS syncs with Mailchimp fail?

Rarely because of the technology. The sync runs, but nobody owns it, nobody watches it and errors pile up unread. The Ricochet Mailchimp AMS Connector sends an automated alert when a sync fails, retries at the next scheduled run and does a monthly true-up of every record, matched on your AMS Member ID.
